thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Canary group 'prefetch-service' showing 95p latency spike (from ~120ms -> ~1.8s) and an increase in 5xx rate over the last 6m. Pager triggered. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/prod/prefetch-canary

maria: I'm on this. Amber, you're currently oncall, right? pulling traces now.

amber: yep i'm oncall. seeing a bunch of 504s hitting model-proxy and queue length on the inference-worker. checking traces -> seems correlated with prefetch_v2 rollout.

samir: fyi i started the prefetch_v2 canary at ~1:00. traffic was at 15% gradually. I saw latency increase ~45m after rollout started. No DB schema changes in this push.

kevin: confirmed. stack traces show slow RPC calls to model-side lookup when prefetch cache misses spike. proposal: flip kill-switch feature flag prefec h_v2.enabled -> false to stop traffic to new codepath.

amber: we can also drain canary weight to 0 in the router. which is faster? flag flip is immediate.

maria: runbook: 1) pause rollout (if traffic controller in play) 2) flip feature flag 3) monitor 95p latency and errors for 5m 4) if needed, manual rollback of deployment 5) verify smoke tests and close. who can flip the flag?

samir: i can toggle the flag. doing it now: ```/feature-toggle set prefetch_v2.enabled false --who=samir```

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Feature toggle recorded by samir. Change ID: fchg-20260317-341.

kevin: flag flipped. Observability: 95p latency dropping already from 1.8s -> 420ms within 60s. 5xx count trending down.

amber: running smoke: ```curl -iS https://api.redwood/prefetch/health || true``` returned 200 ok, no new 5xx in last 90s.

maria: good. amber please keep an eye on customer-facing SLO page and support queue. kevin, can you confirm that rollback is safe (no migrations)? samir, if we still see flakiness after flag flip we'll trigger manual rollback.

kevin: checked the PR. no schema or major runtime contract changes. manual rollback to rev-9843 is safe. I'll stand by to coordinate.

samir: i'm starting manual rollback to rev-9843 now: ```/deploy rollback prefetch-service --to=rev-9843 --initiator=samir```

incident-bot: :rocket: Rollback job started (job-id rb-7722). Estimated completion ~3m.

amber: support volume shows a small uptick from 6 customers hitting timeouts. logged ticket INC-4248 and posted to incident page. pinging CS to triage urgent customers.

maria: great. once rollback completes, runbook verification: 1) verify 95p latency back to baseline 2) run functional smoke suite (smoke-prefetch) 3) confirm no error budget burn 4) create follow-up task to add perf test to gating. I'll prepare the incident doc.

kevin: rb-7722 completed. services report stable. 95p at ~130ms. no new 5xx in last 5m.

amber: smoke-prefetch passed (all checks green). Support queue: customers notified, creating outbound messages for affected customers.

maria: handing off to jules for overnight monitoring in 15m. jules, I'll drop runbook and slack summary in #incidents. action items: add perf regression to model onboarding, add a canary knob to limit pref tech concurrency.

jules: taking over, ack. I'll watch dashboards for next 2 hours and escalate if anything reappears.

maria: thanks everyone. summary will be posted to the incident doc and we'll schedule a postmortem if we still see regression on canary replay. :thumbsup:
